current_view_policy.currency_assumption: NPR; requested by the owner; original source currency remains unconfirmed
current_view_policy.replacement_rates: None; original estimate values remain unchanged
current_view_policy.scope: Measurement compatibility does not establish matching labour, material, grade, installation, VAT or stock
current_view_policy.snapshot_note: V5–V11 are focused views of the shared v9 register. Dated research exports and frozen milestones retain their original scope.

data_architecture.publication: Every source commit runs the existing GitHub Actions build and refreshes all derived views together.
data_architecture.historical_evidence: Original PDF/raw extraction, dated research exports and released milestones remain evidence snapshots.
data_architecture.draft_policy: V8 browser models are temporary scenarios. V10 and v11 share contractor inputs saved on the same browser by source revision and can export as a material CSV. Neither changes the published register or other views until the chosen values are committed to the shared source.
data_architecture.inline_material_view: V11 renders the v10 projection and loads the same generated v10 contractor-data.json; no separately edited material register.
